original_title: CDMX: van 60 policías detenidos en dos años; secuestro y homicidio, entre los delitos perpetrados

meta_description: Between 2024 and 2026, Mexico City’s Attorney General arrested 60 police officers for crimes including kidnapping, homicide, extortion, and femicide, carrying out at least 34 arrest warrants.
